headword: {生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん}

definitions.gloss: lifestyle habits; daily habits; way of living
definitions.explanation: The regular patterns and behaviors that make up one's daily life, including eating, sleeping, exercise, and other routines. Frequently used in health and medical contexts.

examples.japanese: {生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
⟦{不規則|ふきそく}→不規則：15651_fukisoku⟧な{生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪影響|あくえいきょう}→悪影響：16840_akueikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Irregular lifestyle habits have a negative effect on health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦ジョギング→ジョギング：04738_jogingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me to improve my lifestyle habits, so I started jogging every morning.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (life, living) + ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧ (habit, custom). This compound is extremely common in health-related contexts, particularly when discussing prevention of diseases linked to diet, exercise, and sleep patterns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧ — to improve lifestyle habits
- {生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ — to review one's lifestyle habits
- ⟦{生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう}→生活習慣病：08620_seikatsushuukanbyou⟧ — lifestyle-related disease (diabetes, hypertension, etc.)
- ⟦{規則正|きそくただ}しい→規則正しい：20039_kisokutadashii⟧{生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん} — regular lifestyle habits
- ⟦{不規則|ふきそく}→不規則：15651_fukisoku⟧な{生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん} — irregular lifestyle habits

CULTURAL NOTE:
The term ⟦{生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう}→生活習慣病：08620_seikatsushuukanbyou⟧ replaced the older term ⟦{成人病|せいじんびょう}→成人病：17119_seijinbyou⟧ (adult disease) in 1996 to emphasize that these conditions are linked to habits rather than age. This shift reflects Japan's strong public health emphasis on prevention.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦リズム→リズム：04746_rizumu⟧ — life rhythm; focuses on the timing and regularity of daily activities
- ⟦{食生活|しょくせいかつ}→食生活：21071_shokuseikatsu⟧ — eating habits, dietary life; specifically about food
